title: Pet Activity Drop vs Baseline
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whistle:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(active_minutes) as active_minutes by pet_name _time
| streamstats window=7 current=f avg(active_minutes) as baseline by pet_name
| where baseline>0 AND active_minutes<baseline*0.5
| sort active_minutes
description: Compares each pet's daily activity against its recent baseline and surfaces the unusually low days that may reflect illness, injury, or simple boredom.
value: Pets cannot describe how they feel, but their movement patterns often do; a sharp drop can be the clue that starts the right conversation or vet check.
implementation: Forward daily activity totals from a Whistle or similar tracker; alert when activity falls far below the normal seven-day pattern.
visualization: Daily trend of active minutes versus rolling baseline by pet.

references.title: Tractive GPS for dogs and cats

grandmaExplanation: It tracks when your pet is moving much less than usual and may not be feeling right.
